source: from pyspark.sql.functions import col, sum, when,floor, concat,lit, udf, posexplode,  concat_ws, collect_list, asc, desc
from pyspark.sql.types import ArrayType, DoubleType,FloatType, StringType

dfMatriceSconti = spark.sql(f"SELECT psp_id,contract_id,recipient_id,membership_id,countKpi,valueKpi, year_quarter_trx,year_quarter_kpi \
                            FROM pagopa.silver_matricesconti \
                            WHERE year_quarter_trx = '{year_quarter}'")

dfMatriceScontiGold = dfMatriceSconti.groupBy("psp_id", "contract_id", "recipient_id", "membership_id", "year_quarter_trx", "year_quarter_kpi")\
                        .agg(sum(when(col("countKpi") == col("valueKpi"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("KpiOk"))

dfMatriceScontiGold = dfMatriceScontiGold.withColumn("PercSconto",when(col("KpiOk") >= 7, 4).when(col("KpiOk") >=5, 3).otherwise(0))
#dfMatriceScontiGold = dfMatriceScontiGold.filter("PercSconto > 0")

#Mandatari Qualificati
dfContracts = spark.sql("SELECT * FROM pagopa.contracts_raw")
dfContracts = dfContracts.withColumn("Anno", col("year_month").substr(0,4).cast("string"))       
dfContracts = dfContracts.withColumn("Quarter", floor((col("year_month").substr(5, 2).cast("int")-1)/3)+1)

dfContracts = dfContracts.withColumn("Year_Quarter",concat(col("Anno").cast("string"),lit("_"), col("Quarter").cast("string")))

dfMandatariSpeciali = dfContracts.filter(f"Year_Quarter='{year_quarter}'")
dfMandatariSpeciali = dfMandatariSpeciali.withColumn("multiProvider", when(col("provider_names").contains(','),1).otherwise(0) )
dfMandatariSpeciali = dfMandatariSpeciali.filter("multiProvider=1 AND contract_id = recipient_id AND recipient_id = membership_id").select("recipient_id").distinct()
display(dfMandatariSpeciali)

#Leggo tutte le transazioni per l'anno di riferimento

# Read all transactions of the year
df_all_correct_transactions = spark.sql(f'''
    SELECT 
        year,
        quarter,
        month,
        abi,
        category,
        recipient_id,
        contract_type,
        provider_id,
        CAST(n_transactions AS STRING),
        psp_id,
        psp_name,
        year_quarter
    FROM pagopa.trx_quarter
    WHERE year = {reference_year}
''')

# # Get all transactions to be corrected
df_transactions_correction = spark.sql(f'''
    SELECT 
        year_quarter,
        year,
        quarter,
        month,
        abi,
        category,
        recipient_id,
        contract_type,
        provider_id,
        (n_transactions * correction) AS n_transactions,
        cf_psp as psp_id,
        psp as psp_name
    FROM pagopa.missed_trx_quarter
    WHERE year = {reference_year}
''')

# # Add corrected transactions
df_all_transactions = df_all_correct_transactions.unionByName(df_transactions_correction)

#Prendo solo le transazioni dei mandatari qualificati
df_all_transactions = df_all_transactions.join(dfMandatariQualificati,"recipient_id","inner")

df_all_transactions.createOrReplaceTempView("all_transactions")

# Sum of transactions grouped by category for current quarter
current_membership_value = spark.sql(f'''
    SELECT 
        year,
        quarter,
        category,
        sum(n_transactions) AS current_total 
    FROM all_transactions 
    WHERE quarter == {reference_quarter}
    AND year == {reference_year}
    GROUP BY 
        year,
        quarter,
        category
''')

# Sum of transactions grouped by category for previous quarters
previous_transactions_by_category = spark.sql(f'''
    SELECT 
        category, 
        SUM(n_transactions) AS history_transactions 
    FROM all_transactions 
    WHERE quarter < {reference_quarter} 
    AND year = {reference_year} 
    GROUP BY category
''')

# Left join between current transactions and previous transactions
current_membership_basket_value = current_membership_value\
    .join(previous_transactions_by_category, on = "category", how = "left")\
    .fillna(0)\
    .withColumn("currentBasket", evaluateCurrentBasket(col("current_total"), col("history_transactions")))\
    .select("category", "current_total", "currentBasket")

# Sum of current transactions grouped by category and id
current_invoice_df = spark.sql(f'''
    SELECT
        year,
        quarter,
        category,
        recipient_id,
        psp_id,
        SUM(n_transactions) AS n_transactions
    FROM all_transactions
    WHERE quarter == {reference_quarter}
    AND year == {reference_year}
    GROUP BY
        year,
        quarter,
        category,
        recipient_id,
        psp_id

# Evaluate value for fixed costs

# A1 transactions
current_a1_invoice = current_invoice_df\
    .filter(col("category").startswith("A1"))\
    .withColumnRenamed("n_transactions", "current_trx")\
    .withColumn("value", a1TrxValue(col("current_trx").cast("float")))\
    .withColumn("Codice_Articolo", codiceArticolo(col("category"), lit("0")))\
    .select("category", "recipient_id","psp_id", "current_trx", "value", "Codice_articolo")

# B1 transactions
current_b1_invoice = current_invoice_df\
    .filter(col("category").startswith("B1"))\
    .withColumnRenamed("n_transactions", "current_trx")\
    .withColumn("value", b1TrxValue(col("current_trx").cast("float")))\
    .withColumn("Codice_Articolo", codiceArticolo(col("category"), lit("0")))\
    .select("category", "recipient_id","psp_id", "current_trx", "value", "Codice_articolo")

# B2 transactions
current_b2_invoice = current_invoice_df\
    .filter(col("category").startswith("B2"))\
    .withColumnRenamed("n_transactions", "current_trx")\
    .withColumn("value", b2TrxValue(col("current_trx").cast("float")))\
    .withColumn("Codice_Articolo", codiceArticolo(col("category"), lit("0")))\
    .select("category", "recipient_id","psp_id", "current_trx", "value", "Codice_articolo")

# Basket transactions
current_basket_invoice = current_invoice_df\
    .filter(col("category").startswith("G_"))\
    .join(current_membership_basket_value, on = "category", how = "left")\
    .withColumn("perc_trx", col("n_transactions") / col("current_total"))\
    .select("category", "recipient_id","psp_id","perc_trx", posexplode("currentBasket"))\
    .fillna(0)\
    .withColumn("current_trx", col("col") * col("perc_trx"))\
    .withColumn("value", new_basketValue(col("current_trx"), col("pos")))\
    .withColumn("Codice_articolo", codiceArticolo(col("category"), col("pos")))\
    .select("category", "recipient_id","psp_id", "current_trx", "value", "Codice_articolo")\
    .filter(col("value") > 0)

# Unite all categories of transactions 
current_invoice = current_basket_invoice\
    .union(current_a1_invoice)\
    .union(current_b1_invoice)\
    .union(current_b2_invoice)
